cohort: 33 preterm TTTS twins compared to 101 preterm diamniotic-dichorionic (di-di) twins born at <29 weeks of gestational age
finding: Premature TTTS newborns treated with fetal laser therapy had similar survival and neurodevelopmental outcomes compared to preterm di-di twins without TTTS.
mod_finding: Premature newborns with TTTS were more frequently born by C-section compared to preterm di-di twins without TTTS.
